description: This script automates the process of retrieving GitHub repositories with the 'topic:fastapi' tag, compares the data with existing data in a YAML file, and updates the repository by creating a new branch, committing changes, and opening a pull request. It interacts with GitHub via the PyGithub library, manages local file writes, and runs git commands via subprocess.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration class that loads GitHub repository information and token from environment or configuration sources.
classes.,: Defines the configuration settings required to access GitHub, including repository name and token.

classes.name: Repo
classes.description: Data model representing information about a GitHub repository, including name, URLs, star count, and owner info.
classes.,: Defines the structure and fields of a repository data object used within the script.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main execution function that performs GitHub repository searching, data comparison, YAML file update, and Git operations, culminating in creating a pull request.
